title: FBI-UAP-D011, D/FBI Correspondence Referral, 1949
what_is_it: Correspondence between FBI Director J. Edgar Hoover and a civilian witness, with a referral letter to the Atomic Energy Commission (AEC), regarding a reported UAP sighting.
interpretation_warnings: No OCR text was extractable from the PDF; all facts are derived solely from the war.gov catalogue metadata description.
Single civilian witness account with no corroborating observations noted.
The witness was a clergyman, not a trained military or scientific observer.
No indication that any investigation or follow-up by the AEC is documented here.
The nature of the 'beams of light' and 'explosion' is uncharacterised — no physical evidence referenced.
